notes: Created initial story set for EVAL-F-2 with full coverage: schema, logic, facade exposure, URL validation, and tests.

EVAL-F-2-S1.title: Define Provider Detail Response Schema and Contract
EVAL-F-2-S1.description: Define structured response schema for provider detail lookup including NPI attributes, credentials, and external research links (NPI Registry, Healthgrades, state boards). Ensure consistent contract for downstream facade and UI.

EVAL-F-2-S2.title: Implement NPI Registry Lookup and Data Mapping
EVAL-F-2-S2.description: Implement core service logic to call CMS NPI Registry API, parse provider data, normalize credentials, and construct structured provider detail output.

EVAL-F-2-S3.title: Expose Provider Detail via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-F-2-S3.description: Integrate provider detail service into evaluate_care_facade to expose lookup capability through tool routing layer, ensuring compatibility with chat-driven workflows.

EVAL-F-2-S4.title: Integrate External Research Link Generation and Validation
EVAL-F-2-S4.description: Generate external research links (Healthgrades, NPI, state boards) and integrate with URL Guardian for validation to ensure links are live, safe, and correctly formatted.

EVAL-F-2-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Detail Lookup
EVAL-F-2-S5.description: Create unit tests for NPI parsing, credential normalization, and link generation, plus integration tests validating end-to-end provider detail retrieval through facade.

EVAL-F-2.mitigation: Fallback to partial response when NPI API fields are missing; do not block response generation.
